white-tank-waterfall.note: Main Trailhead Staging Area closed for construction through 8/31/26; Waterfall/Ford Canyon Trail remains open but is not reachable from the staging area during the closure. Source: Maricopa County Parks and Recreation.

browns-ranch.note: Brown's Ranch Trailhead closed since July 13, 2026 for improvement construction; no reopening date given. Source: City of Scottsdale McDowell Sonoran Preserve.

thunderbird-h3.note: 59th Avenue Trailhead closed for improvement construction through December 2026; trails remain open but require using the 55th Avenue or 67th Avenue trailheads instead. Source: City of Glendale Parks and Recreation.

devils-bridge.note: Both approaches (Dry Creek Road and Mescal Trailhead) remain closed under the Pocket Fire closure order; the fire is at 95 percent containment but the forest closure order remains in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

boynton-canyon.note: Access closed at the Dry Creek Road/Boynton Canyon Road junction under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

west-fork-oak-creek.note: Oak Creek Canyon (Call of the Canyon/West Fork) closed under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. A separate closure order issued July 19, 2026 additionally closes Oak Creek and a 100-foot buffer on both banks between Call of the Canyon and Sedona due to post-fire flash flood risk. Source: Coconino National Forest.

soldier-pass.note: Soldier Pass Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

bear-mountain.note: Bear Mountain Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

fay-canyon.note: Fay Canyon Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

mescal-courthouse.note: Mescal Trailhead and the Dry Creek Road corridor closed under the Pocket Fire closure order, in effect through September 30, 2026 unless rescinded. Source: Coconino National Forest.

lava-river-cave.note: FR 171, the access road from FR 245 to the Lava River Cave trailhead, is closed to motorized vehicles for maintenance starting July 13, 2026; reaching the cave requires hiking or biking a longer unpaved approach. Source: Coconino National Forest (Forest Order 03-04-08-26-02).

fossil-springs.note: Fossil Creek Wild and Scenic River permit area, including Fossil Creek Road (FR 708) and access to Fossil Springs Trail, is temporarily closed due to hazardous road conditions from monsoon storm damage as of July 18, 2026. Source: Coconino National Forest.

north-kaibab-coconino.note: All water on the North Rim is off, including at the North Kaibab Trailhead; hikers descending toward Coconino Overlook must carry all water they need. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park.
